pre.description: Block only unbounded grep/rg. Piped or self-limiting forms (-c/-l/-q/-m N) pass; the redirect names no tool, since Grep is absent in some sessions

pipeline.message: Unbounded grep floods context. Bound it (-c, -l, -m 20), pipe it (| head -50), or run it in the sandbox: ctx_execute(language: "shell", code: "grep ..."). Use the Grep tool if this session has one — do not assume it exists.

pre.description: Block only unbounded find. Piped or depth-limited forms pass; the redirect names no tool, since Glob is absent in some sessions

pipeline.message: Unbounded find floods context. Bound it (-maxdepth 3), pipe it (| head -50), or run it in the sandbox: ctx_execute(language: "shell", code: "find ..."). Use the Glob tool if this session has one — do not assume it exists.

pre.description: Allow ssh to whitelisted machines. Host is matched in destination position after skipping -o/-x flags, so the alias can't be spoofed from inside a remote command. Edit the host alternation to add machines. Separated flag-args (-i FILE, -p PORT) are not skipped — use -oOpt=val forms or they fall through to a prompt.

Default-ask for docker/podman: settings.json allows `docker *` broadly, this rule takes it back. The whitelist keeps the pre-existing allow set — read-only verbs (ps/inspect/logs/images/stats + network|volume|image|container|system|context|compose sub-verbs) plus run/build/exec — with --context/-H global flags and a pipe tail into filters; rm/rmi/prune/cp/push/pull/login/save/load/compose up/network create/volume rm/context use fall through to a prompt. Anchored ^...$ and separator-free on purpose — a chain or subshell can't smuggle a second call past an allowed prefix. Placed before subshell-allow so its `docker ` prefix can't auto-approve one either. Args must be space-separated from the verb so `build` can't swallow `buildx bake`.
Allow subshells when all parts are permitted
